title: Marguerite and the Garden
author: Xanthe Vasquez
blurb: Ulyana Winterbourne, a bone-carver who hears the dead, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. Then a child arrives at the door speaking a language that predates kingdoms — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must find the door out of a country that no longer exists before the long winter finishes falling.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
